title: Monorepo scaffold and repo layout
description: Create the pnpm workspace with the fixed M0 layout: apps/server (Fastify+ws, @game/server), apps/web (React+Vite, @game/web), packages/schema (@game/schema), packages/engine (@game/rules-engine, placeholder exporting only a version const until M1), infra/ (docker-compose, CI helper scripts), tests/e2e (cross-app proof tests), docs/ (existing). Add root package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, .nvmrc, .gitignore and a README section stating the layout and dependency rule (apps depend on packages; packages never depend on apps; web never imports server).
acceptance: pnpm install succeeds on a clean checkout
pnpm -r build runs in every workspace package and exits 0
README documents the layout and dependency rule
@game/rules-engine exports no game logic in M0

title: TypeScript strict, lint, format, vitest
description: Add tsconfig.base.json (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, project references), ESLint flat config with typescript-eslint and jsx-a11y for apps/web, Prettier, and vitest per package with a root test script. Add a no-restricted-imports rule enforcing the layout dependency rule. Include one trivial passing test per package so the pipeline is proven.
acceptance: tsc --noEmit passes with strict on all packages
pnpm lint fails on a deliberate unused variable and on apps/web importing apps/server
pnpm format:check passes
pnpm -r test runs vitest in every package and passes

title: @game/schema: ids, WS envelope, event and account contracts
description: Define zod schemas and inferred types in packages/schema: branded ids (AccountId, SessionId, ...), client-to-server envelope {actionId,type,payload,lastSeq} and server-to-client sequenced messages (StateSync, PresenceChanged, Error), the event row shape {sessionId,seq,turnId,type,payload,ts}, minimal RoomState (seats, presence, phase=lobby), and API DTOs for signup/login/me (signup input carries birthdate; account output carries isAdult and ageCheckedAt but never a birthdate). This package is the Prism/Forge contract, so it must be published before server or web code consumes it.
acceptance: Every message type has a zod schema, an inferred TS type and a valid and an invalid fixture test
Account DTOs contain no birthdate field; a type-level test asserts it
RoomState schema round-trips JSON through parse
Package has no runtime deps other than zod

title: Local Postgres and migration runner
description: Provide infra/docker-compose.yml with Postgres 16 for dev and test, and choose and wire a SQL migration runner (plain SQL files, node-pg-migrate or equivalent) under apps/server/migrations with up/down scripts and a test-database helper that creates a fresh schema per test file. Document the one-command local setup.
acceptance: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d gives a reachable Postgres
pnpm --filter @game/server migrate:up and migrate:down run clean on an empty database
Test helper returns an isolated schema per test file and drops it afterwards
DATABASE_URL is the only required DB env var, documented in .env.example

title: Migration: events, snapshots, session_lease
description: Create migration for events(session_id, seq, turn_id, type, payload jsonb, ts) with primary key (session_id, seq), append-only enforced by a trigger that blocks UPDATE and DELETE except through a named redaction role/function reserved for the deletion pipeline; snapshots(session_id, seq, state jsonb, created_at); sessions(id, owner_account_id, status, created_at, last_active_at, archived_at); session_lease(session_id, node_id, expires_at). Add expires_at to any log-class table needed later per ADR-017 as a nullable column.
acceptance: Duplicate (session_id, seq) insert fails
Plain UPDATE and DELETE on events fail; the redaction function succeeds
migrate:up then migrate:down leaves no tables
session_lease has one row per session (unique session_id)

title: Migration: accounts, auth_sessions, ws_tickets, tokens, jobs
description: Create migration for accounts(id, email citext unique, password_hash, display_name, status in pending_email|active|suspended|deleting|deleted, is_adult, age_checked_at, terms_version, terms_accepted_at, mature_opt_out default false, created_at, deletion_requested_at); auth_sessions(token_hash, account_id, expires_at, absolute_expires_at, last_active_at, ua_hash, ua_label); ws_tickets(ticket_hash, account_id, session_id, expires_at, used_at); email_tokens(token_hash, account_id, kind verify|reset, expires_at, used_at); export_jobs and deletion_jobs tables. There must be no birthdate, age band, guardian or consent column anywhere (decision round 4).
acceptance: Information-schema test asserts no column named like birthdate, dob, birth_date, age_band, guardian or consent exists
accounts.email is case-insensitively unique
Deleting an account row cascades auth_sessions, ws_tickets and email_tokens
migrate:up and migrate:down are clean

title: Persistence module: append, loadLatest, atomic snapshot
description: Implement the persistence interface in apps/server/src/persistence: append(sessionId, events) with contiguous seq assignment, loadLatest(sessionId) returning latest snapshot plus trailing events, and writeTurn(sessionId, events, snapshot) that writes the last event and snapshot in one transaction. Reject non-contiguous seq. Rewind is out of scope (M3).
acceptance: Concurrent appends to one session never produce a gap or duplicate seq
Snapshot and its last event commit atomically; a forced failure rolls back both
loadLatest returns snapshot + tail events in seq order
Integration tests run against real Postgres

title: Session lease: acquire, renew, release, takeover
description: Implement lease operations over session_lease: acquire (succeeds only if no row or expired), heartbeat renew (only by holder), release, and a fencing token (monotonic lease epoch) that persistence checks on write so a stale node cannot append. Expose configurable TTL and heartbeat interval.
acceptance: Second node cannot acquire a live lease
Second node acquires after expiry and the first node's later append is rejected by the fencing check
Renew by a non-holder fails
Release makes the lease immediately acquirable

title: Room actor skeleton: mailbox, seats, presence, StateSync
description: Implement Room (apps/server/src/room/Room.ts): one actor per session with a serial promise mailbox, owning RoomState in lobby phase. Commands: join(accountId, connection), leave, disconnect, submit(noop echo with actionId idempotency). Presence changes append a PresenceChanged event, broadcast sequenced messages to subscribers, and send StateSync{seq,state} on subscribe/resync using lastSeq. A RoomRegistry hands out the Room for a session id after acquiring the lease. No DM, rules or turn logic.
acceptance: Commands to one Room are processed strictly serially (test with interleaved async commands)
Two joined accounts each receive the other's PresenceChanged with increasing seq
Duplicate actionId is applied once
Subscribe with stale lastSeq receives StateSync; with current lastSeq receives only later events
Room refuses to start without holding the lease

title: Room restart recovery and graceful drain
description: Rebuild a Room from loadLatest (snapshot plus trailing events replayed through the reducer) when a connection arrives after a restart or lease expiry. Implement graceful drain: stop accepting commands, flush, write snapshot, release lease; SIGTERM triggers drain for all rooms. Snapshot after every state-changing command in M0 so max loss is one in-flight command.
acceptance: Test: build state with N events, drop the Room object, rehydrate, state deep-equals the original
Rehydrate works from snapshot only and from snapshot plus tail events
SIGTERM drain releases all leases and exits 0
Clients receive StateSync with the recovered seq after reconnect

title: Server bootstrap, config, logging, OpenTelemetry scaffold
description: Create the Fastify app factory in apps/server/src/app.ts with zod-validated env config, structured JSON logs (pino) with request ids and redaction of cookies and passwords, /healthz and /readyz (DB ping), and an OTel SDK scaffold (traces, OTLP exporter disabled by default, console exporter in dev) with a tracer helper and a sample span on each HTTP request and Room command. No cost or token metrics yet (M2).
acceptance: GET /healthz returns 200; /readyz returns 503 when the DB is unreachable
Invalid or missing env fails fast with a clear message
Log output never contains a Cookie header or password field (test)
Spans are created for HTTP requests and Room commands (in-memory exporter test)

title: Age attestation: server-side 18+ gate and retry block
description: Implement a pure checkAdult(birthdate, now) in apps/server/src/accounts/age.ts returning adult true/false, rejecting future or unparsable dates, and handling leap-day birthdays and the exact 18th birthday boundary using UTC date arithmetic. Add a retry-block cookie helper (short TTL, httpOnly, signed) set on under-18 refusal. The birthdate must never reach a logger, a DB call, or a response.
acceptance: Table-driven tests: exactly 18 today true, one day short false, leap day Feb 29 cases, future date rejected, invalid string rejected
Retry-block cookie is set on refusal and blocks a subsequent attempt with a different birthdate for its TTL
Static test (grep or lint rule) that age.ts has no db or logger imports
Under-18 attempt writes no row to any table (checked in the signup ticket)

title: Accounts and signup with email verification
description: Implement POST /api/signup and GET/POST /api/verify-email. Hash passwords with argon2id (OWASP parameters, configurable cost, tuned about 250 ms), validate password length and common-password list, record terms_version and timestamp, set status pending_email, and persist only is_adult=true and age_checked_at (birthdate discarded after the check). Under-18 returns a neutral refusal and stores no account, flag or birthdate. Verification token is single-use, hashed at rest, 24 h expiry, sent through an EmailSender interface (console and in-memory implementations; SMTP provider adapter stubbed). Responses never reveal whether an email is registered; per-IP and per-email rate limits; display name passes a pluggable name filter hook (no-op until M3).
acceptance: Adult signup creates exactly one accounts row with is_adult=true, age_checked_at set, status pending_email, and no birthdate stored anywhere (DB dump grep and column test)
Under-18 signup returns the neutral refusal, creates no row in accounts or any table, and sets the retry-block cookie
Duplicate-email signup returns the same response shape and timing class as a new email
Password stored as an argon2id hash; plaintext absent from logs
Verification link works once, fails after 24 h, activates the account; unverified accounts are marked not allowed to host or join
Rate limit returns 429 past the configured threshold

title: Login, logout, cookie sessions, device sessions
description: Implement POST /api/login, /api/logout, GET /api/me, GET /api/sessions, DELETE /api/sessions/:id and sign-out-everywhere. Sessions are opaque random tokens stored as hashes in auth_sessions; cookie is httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax; 30-day sliding and 90-day absolute expiry; Origin check on mutating routes; identical error for unknown email and wrong password; throttling at 5 failures in 10 minutes with exponential delay; revocation effective immediately; re-enter current password for password or email change.
acceptance: Login with a pending_email account is refused with an actionable verification message
Wrong password and unknown email return byte-identical bodies
Logout invalidates the token on the very next request
Sixth failure within 10 minutes is delayed or blocked per the throttle
Revoking a device session blocks that session within 60 s (test asserts immediate)
Sliding expiry extends; absolute 90-day expiry rejects
Mutating request with bad Origin is rejected 403

title: Password reset
description: Implement POST /api/password-reset/request and /confirm using email_tokens kind=reset: single-use, hashed at rest, 1 h expiry; request always returns the same response regardless of email existence; confirm sets a new argon2id hash and revokes all other device sessions.
acceptance: Reset link works once and fails after use and after 1 h
Request response and timing class are identical for known and unknown emails
Successful reset revokes every other auth_session
Old password no longer logs in; new one does

title: WS gateway with one-time tickets
description: Implement POST /api/ws-ticket (authenticated, scoped to a session id the account is seated in or joining) issuing a 30 s single-use ticket stored hashed in ws_tickets, and a /ws endpoint on Fastify+ws that consumes the ticket on upgrade, binds the connection to accountId, validates every inbound message against @game/schema, routes to the Room by lease (sticky; refuse with a retry hint if another node holds it), heartbeats and cleans up on close. Origin check on upgrade.
acceptance: Ticket works exactly once; second use is rejected
Expired ticket is rejected
Ticket for session A cannot open a connection to session B
Connection without a ticket or with a bad Origin is closed with a policy code
Malformed message gets an Error message and does not crash the Room
Disconnect produces PresenceChanged for remaining clients

title: Create room and invite link endpoints
description: Implement POST /api/sessions (create a lobby room owned by the account), GET /api/sessions (my rooms), POST /api/sessions/:id/invite (generate or regenerate a revocable per-session secret link), and POST /api/join/:code (requires login, seats the account, returns session id for ticket request). Unverified accounts cannot create or join. Join code is stored hashed.
acceptance: Verified account can create a room and sees it in the list; unverified gets 403
Valid invite code seats the caller; revoked or regenerated code fails
Unauthenticated join returns 401 with a body the web app can use to redirect to login and return
Seat limit of 6 enforced

title: Account export and deletion skeleton
description: Implement POST /api/account/export (re-auth) creating an export_jobs row and a worker that writes a JSON archive (profile fields, own seats, session list; no birthdate since none exists) to a local-disk object store interface, with a signed link valid 7 days; and POST /api/account/delete (re-auth, typed confirmation) that sets status deleting, revokes all sessions at once and creates a deletion_jobs row. Hard-delete execution lives in the sweeper ticket. Skeleton only: characters, snapshots, transcripts are added in later milestones.
acceptance: Export produces a downloadable JSON containing profile and seats and expires after 7 days
Delete without correct password or confirmation text is refused
After delete the user cannot log in and all existing sessions are invalid immediately
Delete request response states it cannot be undone
Object-store interface has a local-disk implementation and is swappable

title: retention-sweeper skeleton (30-day)
description: Implement the idempotent nightly sweeper (apps/server/src/retention/sweeper.ts, runnable as pnpm --filter @game/server sweep and via an in-process scheduler): purge log-class rows past expires_at (30 days), purge expired exports (7 days) and expired tokens, and run the account-deletion pipeline: for deleting accounts hard-delete the accounts row and PII, and mark membership/seats anonymized. Each job logs counts only and is individually testable; sweep records last_completed_at and exposes a metric/health flag that is stale after 26 hours. Legal-hold flag check is a stub that skips held items and writes an audit row.
acceptance: Seed expired and unexpired rows; sweep deletes only expired ones; second run deletes nothing
A deleting test account is fully removed (accounts row, auth_sessions, tokens, export files) and a second sweep is a no-op
Held item is skipped and audited
Sweeper logs contain counts and ids, no email or text
Staleness flag turns true when last_completed_at is older than 26 h (fake clock)

title: Mock Room and auth server for Prism
description: Build a standalone mock server in apps/web/mock (Node, started by pnpm --filter @game/web mock) that speaks the @game/schema contract: fake signup/login/me/export/delete endpoints with in-memory state (including birthdate under-18 refusal), ws-ticket and /ws with a trivial Room that supports join, presence, StateSync, and a scripted second participant. This unblocks Prism before the real server lands; it must import schemas from @game/schema so contract drift fails typecheck.
acceptance: Mock starts with one command and serves all endpoints the web app calls in M0
Mock responses are validated against @game/schema in a test
Two browser tabs joined to one mock room see each other's presence
Under-18 birthdate yields the same refusal shape as the real contract

title: Web app shell, a11y tokens, routing, test setup
description: Create the Vite+React app shell with router, layout landmarks (header, main, nav, skip link), and a design-token layer: colors meeting 4.5:1 text and 3:1 graphical contrast in light and dark, a colorblind-safe palette option, focus-ring token, spacing and type scale, a dyslexia-friendly font option, and prefers-reduced-motion handling. Choose Radix or React Aria primitives. Set up Testing Library and jest-axe, and a Playwright config under apps/web for component and e2e runs.
acceptance: Skip link and landmarks present; focus ring visible on every interactive element
Token contrast checks run in a unit test and fail if a pair is below threshold
prefers-reduced-motion disables transitions (test)
jest-axe reports zero violations on the shell
Text-size and dyslexia-font toggles persist in localStorage

title: WS client and room reducer
description: Implement the Room client in apps/web/src/room: ticket fetch then WebSocket connect, auto-reconnect with exponential backoff, client-generated actionId, lastSeq resync, and a pure reducer applying StateSync and sequenced patches (PresenceChanged) to client RoomState from @game/schema. Expose a useRoom hook and a connection-status model rendered through a polite live region.
acceptance: Reducer unit tests: StateSync replaces state, out-of-order or duplicate seq ignored, gap triggers resync request
Reconnect after socket drop resumes with lastSeq and ends in the correct state against the mock
Connection status changes are announced via aria-live=polite
Client parses all inbound messages with @game/schema and surfaces schema errors without crashing

title: Lobby and invite screens
description: Build My Rooms, Create Room, Lobby (seat list with live presence, copy-invite-link, regenerate link) and Join-by-link screens. Unauthenticated visitors are redirected to login or signup and returned to the join afterwards. Everything is keyboard-operable with labelled controls; presence changes announced politely. Runs against the mock server.
acceptance: Opening a join link while logged out redirects to login then back to the join
Lobby shows two participants live when two tabs join the mock room
Copy-link button gives accessible success feedback
jest-axe zero violations and full keyboard path covered by a Playwright test
Layout works at 360 px width

title: Signup (birthdate), verify, login, reset screens
description: Build signup (email, password, display name, native date input for birthdate, Terms/Privacy acceptance with versions, 18+ statement), check-your-email and verify-result pages, login, forgot/reset password. Under-18 refusal shows a neutral non-leaky message and no retry affordance beyond the cookie block. Errors are associated with fields (aria-describedby) and announced; no client-side age decision is trusted (display only server result). The birthdate field is never stored in client storage or logs.
acceptance: Signup submits birthdate to the API and renders the server's under-18 refusal neutrally
Birthdate value absent from localStorage, sessionStorage and console output (Playwright check)
Field errors programmatically associated and announced
Login error text is identical for unknown email and wrong password
jest-axe zero violations on each screen; keyboard-only completion in Playwright

title: Account settings: sessions, export, delete
description: Build the account settings screen: display name, password change (current password required), device session list with revoke and sign-out-everywhere, Export my data (status and download link), and Delete account (re-auth, typed confirmation, irreversible warning). Mature opt-out toggle is out of scope until M3.
acceptance: Device list shows label and last active; revoking a session updates the list
Delete requires password and the exact confirmation phrase and shows the cannot-be-undone text
Export shows pending, ready (link), and expired states
jest-axe zero violations; destructive actions reachable and operable by keyboard; confirmation dialog traps and restores focus

title: CI workflow: typecheck, lint, test, build, Postgres service
description: Add .github/workflows/ci.yml running on push and PR: pnpm install with cache, typecheck, lint, format check, vitest across workspaces with a Postgres 16 service container and migrations applied, build, and Playwright component/e2e smoke against the mock server. Add a nightly job that runs the retention sweeper tests. Pin Node and pnpm versions; fail on lockfile drift.
acceptance: Workflow passes on a clean branch and fails when a test, lint rule, or typecheck is broken
Postgres service is used by server tests (no skipped DB tests)
Artifacts (Playwright traces) uploaded on failure
Lockfile drift fails the job
verify: act -j test (or push a branch and read the CI run)

title: M0 exit-criteria proof tests
description: Write the end-to-end proof suite in tests/e2e against the real server and web app (not the mock) with Postgres: (1) two verified accounts join one room and both see synced presence; (2) restart the server process mid-session and show state and seq survive and clients reconnect; (3) under-18 signup is refused, no row exists in accounts, and a DB-wide scan finds no birthdate for any adult account either; (4) a seeded test account requests deletion, the sweeper runs, and the account and its PII are gone. Produce docs/plan/m0-proof-report.md listing each exit criterion with the command, result and any gap.
acceptance: Test 1: two accounts in one room each observe the other's presence within 3 s
Test 2: kill -TERM and restart the server; reconnected clients show identical state and seq; rehydrate completes in 3 s or less
Test 3: under-18 refused; query of all tables finds no birthdate-like data for any account
Test 4: after deletion plus sweeper, no row references the test account id or email
All four tests pass in CI and locally; report states what remains unverified
